ARCHER Ltd.OFFSHORE

Established in 2022 as part of the Archer Recruitment Group, we are a fast-growing agency with offices in Fareham, Aberdeen, and Dubai

We specialise in Offshore Construction, Renewables and Oil & Gas, with expertise across ROV, Pipelay, Diving and Inspection

Since 2022, we've connected skilled professionals with critical offshore roles across ROV, survey, diving, trades, technical and inspection.
